description:
Leidos is seeking a talented Junior CEMA Software Engineer in Lawton, OK to join our local development team to create unique solutions for complex problems in engineering, spectrum warfare, and defense domains.

 As a Junior CEMA Software Engineer, you will bring your passion for software design and development to design, build, deploy, and maintain mission critical solutions that support our customers’ mission objectives.

 Our team is primarily in-person in Lawton. Culturally, we place emphasis on trust, respect, asynchronous communication, creativity, and valuing the mission of our customers.

 Primary Responsibilities 
 Develop simulations to emulate threat-representative Cyber and Electromagnetic Activities (CEMA) effects and environments.
 Support a team of software engineers in developing offensive or defensive cyber tools focused on radar, C2, surface-to-air, and artillery systems.
 Research current and future cybersecurity threats against military systems.
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical degree.
 Candidate must be willing to travel approx. 10% each year if necessary — moderate travel to testing locations, typically CONUS.
 Experience with Agile software development, CI/CD toolchains, and DevOps (e.g., Atlassian suite, git, Jenkins, Artifactory)
 Proficient in Python (OOP) or C++
 Experience working as a member of a Scrum team, contributing to iterative development and Agile collaboration
 Interest in cyber security
 Must live in or be willing to relocate to Lawton, OK.
 Candidate must be a US Citizen and meet the eligibility to obtain (and be able to maintain) a Final Top-Secret clearance.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in software architecture and design
 Deep understanding of Linux platforms
 Experience with Modern C++ (17/20) standards
 Experience with Pyside,QT,QML,
 Understanding of multi-threaded programming
 Experience and interest in cybersecurity
 Experience and interest in fundamental networking implementations and concepts
 Experience and interest in machine learning and data science
 Experience with the following tools, concepts, and products is a plus: Ubuntu, Red Hat, Kali Linux, or similar
 Networking Protocols
 Wireshark
 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
October 2, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $57,850.00 - $104,575.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
